description: This file defines a PHP class for the XHTML 1.1 Ruby Annotation Module within the HTMLPurifier library, specifying elements for annotation or pronunciation cues in HTML documents.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Ruby
classes.description: A class representing the Ruby Annotation Module for XHTML 1.1, adding elements like ruby, rb, rt, rbc, rtc, rp used for pronunciation and annotation.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the module by adding necessary elements for ruby annotations into the HTMLPurifier configuration.
